title: Build candidate intake and profile
changes: packages/domain: JSON Schema 2020-12 contracts (common, evidence, skill, experience, education, certification, intake-source, candidate-profile, profile-draft, intake-request, intake-result), Ajv 2020 validators, TypeScript mirrors and skill/role taxonomy
packages/ingestion: PDF extraction (unpdf), image OCR adapters (alt-text, tesseract, vision, chained) and unified extractText returning a provenance-carrying IntakeSource
packages/profile: deterministic heuristic extractor, normalization with a declared-only level cap, experience-type detection, relevance classification and buildProfile
apps/agent-runtime: ProfileAgent, LLM profile extractor, OpenRouter chat/vision adapters, PII redaction and createAgentFromEnv with a resilient heuristic fallback
apps/web: Next.js intake UI (IntakeForm), POST /api/intake route, pure handleIntake, handler tests and .env.example
docs: README run instructions and CONTEXT.md confirmed stack

skipped: gate-ide lint/format/spellcheck: no eslint/prettier/cspell configured in the repo
gate-ci semgrep/snyk/k6: security and performance scanners are not configured in the repo; npm audit reported 0 vulnerabilities
node .agents/skills/platform/check-all.mjs: pre-existing failure, policy/tool-risk-budget.json is referenced by the script but was never tracked in this repo
validation.notes: Provenance drives the rules: pdf/image sources are extracted, text/audio_transcript are declared, and declared-only skills are capped at level 1. The end-to-end smoke test returned HTTP 200 with a schema-valid CandidateProfile containing a family_business experience classified partially_relevant, declared skills at level 1 and needs_review=true.

riskRemaining: Heuristic extraction quality is imperfect: section headers can surface as experiences or certifications and sentence titles are sometimes truncated (e.g. 'Ayudaba en la tienda de mi familia los'). These are cosmetic issues in the deterministic path, not contract or classification failures. The optional tesseract.js OCR fallback is intentionally uninstalled and aliased to a stub. Mastra workflow orchestration, candidate preferences (ticket #7) and the safety plane (ticket #9) remain out of scope.
